description: Report students who may need instructor attention based on inactivity, missing or late submissions, and low current score. Each finding lists the exact signals that fired and the thresholds used — this is a factual report, not a prediction. Requires instructor/TA permissions in the course.

inactive_days.description: Flag students with no activity in the last N days (default 7)

min_late.description: Flag students with at least N late submissions (default 3)

min_missing.description: Flag students with at least N missing submissions (default 1)

score_threshold.description: Flag students with a current score below this value (default 70)

name: list_students_needing_attention
title: List Students Needing Attention
